about: Modwerk source-only euclidean packages for Digitakt I OS 1.53 and 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/euclidean.

mods.title: Euclidean Sequencing
mods.summary: Generate rhythms from two pulse generators on each audio or MIDI track. Rotate either generator, rotate the whole result and combine them with OR, XOR, AND or SUB.
mods.description: Generate rhythms from two pulse generators on each audio or MIDI track. Rotate either generator, rotate the whole result and combine them with OR, XOR, AND or SUB.
mods.author: sumedho
mods.on_unit: The author tested 1.1.6 on a Digitakt 1, OS 1.53 and 1.54, with all six mods and alone, including project save/reload and a power cycle (2026-11-04): holding FUNC while turning D off no longer clicks the audio, and converts the rhythm to ordinary trigs.
